summary.text: Mark Elworth Jr., who campaigns as "Marky Jr," is the Libertarian Party candidate for Colorado's 5th District. According to Ballotpedia he was born in Omaha, Nebraska, and worked as a salesman. In his candidate survey he says he is running to challenge the two-party system, cut government spending and legalize marijuana nationwide.

paragraphs.text: Born in Omaha, Nebraska, per Ballotpedia.
Graduated from the VanEd Educational Center in 2015 and has worked as a salesman, per Ballotpedia.
Nominated by the Libertarian Party of Colorado as its 2026 candidate for Congressional District 5.
In his Ballotpedia survey, describes himself as challenging "the 2 party system and the status quo," and says he does not accept donations.
